one_line: Three one-line theme labels over a hands-only page flip, and a small box that sends viewers to the caption.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a parquet floor: two hands swing a colourful picture-book cover open, no text yet. By 0:01 three stacked labels over a rabbit spread: "פחדים", "אומץ לנסות משהו חדש", "אמונה ביכולת שלי להתמודד". No speech.
q1_hook.why: Motion and a handled book in the first frame (H1, S1), with the topic labels one second later (T3). "פחדים" names a parent concern in one word (K6). The labels give themes, not an outcome for the child, so the value is slow to land (H2), and there is no voice or face (H4).

beats.what: Two hands swing the colourful cover open; no text yet
beats.why: Motion first, a book in hand.

beats.what: Rabbit in a scarf beside a forest page; the three labels appear
beats.why: The three themes are read while the book is shown.

beats.what: Page turned to an underwater spread with otters and fish; labels unchanged
Another page mid-turn; a low box appears: "איך הספר עוזר להתכונן ל1.9? בתיאור 👇"
beats.why: The one prompt, sending viewers to the caption.

beats.what: Forest spread with running deer; a finger points at the page at 0:07
beats.why: A pointing finger adds movement to the end.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen from 0:05: "איך הספר עוזר להתכונן ל1.9? בתיאור 👇" points to the caption, which lists four questions to ask the child. No comment, send or save ask.
q2_flow.why: A page turn about every 2 s keeps the picture changing (R3, E1), but the text only changes once, at the 0:05 box, so nothing builds or pays off (K2, R4). That box opens a small gap closed only in the caption (H5). At 8 s it is easy to finish (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen from about 0:05: "איך הספר עוזר להתכונן ל1.9? בתיאור 👇". Not said aloud. Caption: no explicit ask, only four questions to put to a child and a note that nobody has to be brave.
q3_cta.why: One action, read the caption, with a real payoff there: the story and four questions (C1, C2). It is shown but not said, sits at about 80 to 87% down in the bottom 35%, and the caption's first line does not repeat it (C6, F2). No send ask (C4).

q4_shown.what: Hands only on a parquet floor: two hands open the cover, turn to a rabbit page, an underwater spread, a forest spread with running deer; a finger points at 0:07. Three theme labels throughout. No child, face, title or price.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled from frame 0 (S1) and the colourful pages are large (F4). Hands only keeps a child off screen (S4, S5). There is no reaction or first-person verdict, so the professional voice comes only through the text and caption (S6).

q5_edit.what: One shot of 8 s, no cuts, handheld top-down (the framing shifts a little). Labels appear by 0:01, the low box by 0:05, both stay to the end. Page turns near 0:03 and 0:05, a finger point at 0:07. No speech. Ends on the point.
q5_edit.why: One take with fixed text is quick to film and short (R1, R2). Page turns give a new picture about every 2 s (R3, E1), but no cut, new line of text or sound cue marks a build (E2, E4). It ends on a held point with no wrap-up (E8).

q6_topic.what: A picture book about fears and trying something new, tied to the school start (caption: "לקראת ה־1.9"). Serves a parent whose child faces a new gan or class.
q6_topic.why: The school start is a dated, shared worry and fear and courage are real parent concerns (K6, K7). The caption's four questions give a use for the book, and "nobody has to be brave" keeps the tone modest (K4). The video alone shows labels with no feeling or reaction (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down phone shot on a parquet floor in daylight: an open picture book, two hands (rings, a bracelet) turning pages, a finger pointing at 0:07. No face, no child. Full frame, no borders.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on large colourful pages, child-free (F5, S4, S5), full-screen and sharp (F1, F3). The three labels cover the middle of the art, which is the draw (T2). A real home floor and natural light give the creator look (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: Rounded semi-transparent white boxes with black Hebrew text, centred, from 0:01 to the end: "פחדים" (about 35% down), "אומץ לנסות משהו חדש" (46%), "אמונה ביכולת שלי להתמודד" (57%). From 0:05 a small box at about 80 to 87%: "איך הספר עוזר להתכונן ל1.9? בתיאור 👇". No title, no subtitles.
q8_text.caption: "טיפ טיפה אמיץ🐰" (the book's title). About 140 words: the school-start context, the story, the themes, four questions for the child with 🐰, a note that nobody has to be brave. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Big dark labels held all Reel read muted (T1, T5), though they cover the art (T2). The pointer box is in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption names the book, the occasion and the themes in parents' words, but has no hashtags (T7).

weak_points: No book title in the video; no voice, child or feeling; labels cover the art; the pointer box comes late and sits in the bottom band; no hashtags; the value sits in a caption many will not open.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a top-down page flip of one LumeBook page with three short theme labels, then a small "בתיאור 👇" box pointing to the caption's questions.
not_verified: The audio (no speech, not silent at mean -17.0 dB, no sticker, so likely music, unconfirmed); whether the pages shown belong to the book named in the caption (a rabbit page fits, the cover title is not seen); that 1.9 means 1 September (the caption does not say); whether one or two people run the account (the caption says "ממליצות"). Corrections to the first pass: the 0:00 frame has no text, the labels are there by 0:01; the pointer box sits about 80 to 87% down; no borders. Plays 1,264, likes 26 on 15 Oct are context only.
